artworks.title: Second Street Market, Philadelphia
artworks.description: The image shows an urban scene with a low point of view, highlighting a busy market area. Buildings create a horizon line, contrasting with the sky. The sketch-style rendering features expressive brushstrokes capturing movement. Sepia tones and grey shades give a nostalgic feel. Figures are shown engaging in various activities near a market structure. Buildings in the distance expand the urban landscape, with a simple sky background.

artworks.title: The Bridges, from Brooklyn
artworks.description: This image depicts an urban scene from a street-level perspective. The view shows a city setting with tall buildings and a suspension bridge across the top. The bridge has intricate cable patterns and stone towers. Below the bridge, there are various city buildings along the street. The artwork resembles an etching with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is primarily sepia, giving the scene a historical feel. The streets are busy with horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians.

artworks.title: London over Charing Cross Bridge
artworks.description: The image displays an elevated view showcasing complex architectural structures and a busy bridge scene. A stone bridge with arches spans a river in the distance, while a steel bridge carries a steam locomotive closer to the foreground. The painting features fine, sketch-like brushstrokes and a color palette of gray tones. Various architectural styles are visible in the skyline, with a mixture of Gothic and contemporary buildings. The scene conveys an atmosphere of industrial movement and architectural diversity.

artworks.title: Shot Tower between the Bridges
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban riverside scene portrayed in an etching style. The perspective is elevated, showing a wide view of the environment. Various industrial and architectural structures, including a tall cylindrical chimney building, dominate the skyline. Detailed linework captures the buildings, a bridge over the river, and boats with sails and figures. In the background, there are industrial structures like a bridge and buildings with smoke stacks, suggesting an industrious harbor city. The color palette is monochromatic, mostly black and white.

artworks.title: Williamsburg from the Bridge (Sketch)
artworks.description: The image shows a waterway with boats, rendered in fine line work. In the background, there is a cityscape with various buildings, including one with a dome and spires. The water takes up most of the image, with light strokes suggesting ripples. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black ink. Closest to the viewer is a rooftop and part of a boat or barge.

artworks.title: Suzanna Rose
artworks.description: This image is a bust view of a woman, capturing her head and shoulders in a semi-profile position facing to the left. Her facial features are prominently displayed, with a slightly furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. Her hair is styled into neat curls at the sides and is covered with a detailed lace bonnet adorned with ribbons and floral patterns, extending over her shoulders. The woman wears a garment with a high collar featuring intricate lace detailing. The background is plain and lightly textured with lines. There is text in the upper corners and a signature with a date at the bottom left.

artworks.title: Matthew Boulton, F.R.S.
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting in a chair, facing slightly to his right. He has a serious expression with distinct facial features, like a slightly furrowed brow and calm eyes. His hair is styled in a typical 18th-century fashion, with voluminous, wavy gray hair. He wears a dark coat with a deep collar, large buttons, and a white cravat. He holds a small round object in one hand and an upturned cup in the other. He sits in an ornately carved chair next to a table with folded fabrics or documents. In the background are classical-style buildings against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Preparing to Start
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse racing scene. The setting is an outdoor area with green hills in the background. Numerous horses and riders are assembled in the foreground, preparing for a race. Large crowds are gathered near tents or a viewing area. The sky is lightly clouded. Various figures, dressed in colorful outfits, are involved in different activities. A small wooden stand with a red roof is occupied by several individuals overseeing the event. Light, pastel colors and details suggest a joyful and dynamic setting, capturing the excitement and energy of the moment.

artworks.title: Racing
artworks.description: The image shows a horse race from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon cuts across the upper third, revealing hills, trees, and buildings in the distance. In the foreground, jockeys in colorful attire race on horses at full speed on a track. A crowd of spectators lines the track, with some in carriages, adding depth to the scene. The brushstrokes are light and detailed, emphasizing the speed of the race. The color palette includes pastel blues, greens, warm earth tones, and vibrant colors, creating a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Successful Fortune Hunter
artworks.description: The image depicts a caricature of two figures, a man and a woman, walking down a street. The man is on the left, slightly leaning towards the woman and holding a cane. He has a large nose, pronounced chin, wearing a black bicorne hat with a feather, and a red and gold military-style uniform. The woman is smiling, with a rounded face and curly hair with a white feather decoration. She wears a green dress with pink ribbons, yellow gloves, and pink shoes, holding a fan. In the background, there is a building named "Crescent" in a Georgian terrace style. A man in a blue coat carries a chair, and another man leans on a walking stick.

artworks.title: Comfort in the Gout
artworks.description: The image shows four adults and a dog in an interior space. On the left, a man is seated in an armchair, while a woman stands beside him holding a bowl. In the background, another woman holds a tray with a glass and decanter, and a man is holding a dish. The dog is lying in front of the footstool. The setting is warmly lit, conveying a domestic atmosphere with draped curtains in muted shades of pink and green.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group scene with multiple figures in a medieval setting. The central figure is standing at the threshold of a doorway, surrounded by a crowd of people in various states of action and expression. The central figure is barefoot, clad in robes, and crowned with thorns. Other individuals around them are dressed in period attire with details like hats and armor, exhibiting gestures of interaction or confrontation. The background shows architecture with an arched doorway and battlements. In the foreground, a small dog is lying down. The drawing features intricate linework and detailed shading techniques, creating a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Nativity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nativity scene featuring animals and architectural arches. The scene is depicted under a gothic arch ruin with brick and stonework detail. Vines climb over the arches. The setting shows a child resting on a draped cloth, surrounded by a calf and a donkey. Above the arch, ethereal figures appear. The shading and use of line create depth, showing the artist's skill in creating a sense of depth and texture in this monochrome depiction.

artworks.title: Copy After a Historical Painting from the Circle of Paolo Veronese [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalkon laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows abstract lines and shapes drawn in pencil and ink on paper. On the left, there are flowing lines that suggest a seated figure and on the right, there are standing figures in conversation. Above them is a shape resembling a sleeve.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.artist: Sir Anthony van Dyck and Attributed to Lucas Emil Vorsterman
artworks.description: The image shows three men's upper bodies. The central figure is seated with his head tilted slightly downward. He has long hair and a beard and wears a crown of thorns. He appears serene. On either side are two men, one wearing a robe and gesturing, the other in armor and a helmet, holding a stick. A radiant light emanates from the central man's head. The background is dark, and there is Latin text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Style of Lucas van Leyden after Albrecht Dürer
artworks.description: The image depicts an illustration of a man from the waist up. He is in a three-quarter view with his face turned slightly to the right. The man has distinct facial features with high cheekbones, a straight nose, and a prominent chin. His hair is short and straight, with some falling over his forehead. He wears a large brimmed hat casting a shadow over his eyes, and his garment has a high collar and a textured appearance. Below the waist, the garment is detailed with fine cross-hatching. The man is not depicted with any visible jewelry or objects. The background is a finely cross-hatched surface, providing a textured, neutral setting for the portrait.

artworks.title: Village Kermesse with Drinkers Under a Tree
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene with several people gathered along a dirt path. In the distance, a church tower emerges among trees. To the right, a large tree spreads its branches over a group of people engaged in interactions by a thatched-roof building. The building's roof is adorned with a flowing flag. The etching technique highlights intricate lines for texture on foliage, clothing, and structures. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Two Peasant Women Conversing on a Village Street
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic village scene. The image features two figures in long, frock-like garments and head coverings at the center, engaged in conversation. Behind them are structures resembling cottages or farmhouses with thatched roofs, with additional figures in the background. One figure can be seen working at a spinning wheel. Trees and shrubbery overhead add a natural element to the scene. In the foreground, there is a depiction of rural life with a farm animal. The drawing conveys a busy yet harmonious rural environment.

artworks.title: Peasant Leaning on His Doorway
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 10.6 × 9.2 cm (4 3/16 × 3 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning on a wooden ledge at the entrance of a building. Their upper body is visible with arms crossed on the ledge. The individual's head is tilted downwards, partly obscured by a cap. They wear a jacket with a buttoned-up collar. The surroundings include wooden framework, a diamond-patterned window to the left, and foliage above. The background consists of detailed wood patterns and adjacent window designs, creating a textured scene.

artworks.title: Smoker on a Stool Conversing with a Cobbler at Work
artworks.medium: etching, with touches of drypoint, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a shoemaker's workshop attached to the side of a house. The scene depicts a small outdoor workspace with a thatched roof, where a figure is seated on a stool, engaged in the craft of shoemaking. Next to this figure is a lower door to the workshop, partially open. On top of the roof lies a small dog, curled up and asleep. The backdrop includes an exterior wall adorned with climbing ivy and a multi-paned window, while various tools and items, such as brooms and a water pump, are scattered around in the frame. The detailed linework complements the textures throughout the drawing, giving a sense of everyday life from a bygone era.

artworks.title: The Blacksmith's Shop
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man in a workshop. He is standing in a side profile, with short, wavy hair and his focus directed downward. He is wearing a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a vest or apron covering his torso. The man is holding a tool or object in his hand. The setting is a blacksmith workshop, with various tools visible, including prominent anvils. A workbench on the right side is cluttered with tools. Light enters through a large window, revealing some greenery outside. Another small window on the left shows the exterior of a building and vegetation. The artwork uses crosshatching and line work to capture the textures of the workshop environment.

artworks.title: The Little Student
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a child seated at a table, engaged in an activity. The child's upper body is visible, with their attention focused on the table. Their facial features are delicate, and they have straight, chin-length hair parted in the middle. The child wears a long-sleeved garment with a round collar and billowy sleeves. On the table are paper and objects that resemble pens or pencils, including what appears to be a quill. In the background, there is a window with multi-paned glass, letting in light that casts a shadow in the room.

artworks.title: Harbor Scene with Mountainous Background
artworks.description: The image displays a maritime scene with ships sailing on a calm sea. Two large sailing ships are depicted with detailed rigging and sails. In the background, there are more ships on the left side and a rocky landmass with buildings. The sky shows softly rendered clouds with a monochromatic color palette, resembling an etched and inked artwork.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for Callot's "The New Testament"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative frame with a central inscription and baroque elements. The central panel features an inscription in French, describing a New Testament facsimile by Jacques Callot and referencing the year 1635. It is framed by swirling, flowing scrollwork with cross motifs at the corners. Above the inscription, there is a cherubic face with wings. The design is intricate and highly detailed, using lines and cross-hatching to create depth and texture.
